# CANDIDATE: OPENING_GAP_VWAP_RETEST_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A gap down that fails to reclaim VWAP within the first half hour signals weak buying pressure and a likely continuation lower. This edge exists because initial gap-down momentum often lacks follow-through buying, causing price to remain below VWAP as selling pressure persists, especially when confirmed by bearish EMA ribbon and oversold RSI.

## Mechanism
Entry: If opening price gaps down > 0.5% from prior close AND price does not close above VWAP within the first 30 minutes (30‑minute bar’s close < VWAP) AND 5‑EMA < 20‑EMA (bearish ribbon) AND RSI(14) < 40, go short at the close of the 30‑minute bar. Exit: Stop at high of opening bar (first 5‑minute bar after open); initial target at 1.5R; if price reaches 2R without hitting stop, trail with chandelier exit (ATR(2) x 2) to capture runner.
